key.name: binary-path
key.description: Absolute path to the RyzenAdj executable. Leave empty to autodetect from PATH and common install locations.

key.name: profiles
key.description: JSON array of power profiles. Each entry has id, name, stapm/fast/slow (watts) and tctl (°C). An empty string means the built-in defaults.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often power metrics are read via ryzenadj --info.

key.name: auto-apply-profile
key.summary: Re-apply the last selected profile automatically
key.description: Some systems reset CPU power limits after a reboot, on resume, or when the charger state changes. When enabled, the last profile applied from the menu is restored at those points.

key.name: last-profile
key.summary: Id of the last profile applied from the menu
key.description: Recorded on every profile apply, independent of auto-apply-profile. Also disambiguates profiles whose limits are identical.

key.name: performance-mode
key.description: One of 'default', 'power-saving', 'max-performance'. The platform flips these automatically on AC plug/unplug, so the selection is persisted here and re-asserted by the extension on power-source changes. 'default' means the platform manages itself.

key.name: panel-rows
key.summary: Number of text rows in the panel widget

key.name: panel-font-family
key.summary: Font family for the panel widget
key.description: Empty string follows the system interface font (org.gnome.desktop.interface font-name).
